name: wide_bn_ensemble_distill
teacher_rule: mean of three fixed wide_bn raw logits per source row; teacher checkpoints were selected before this run

permissions.source_labels: classification gradient and metrics; teacher soft targets are source-only
permissions.valid_labels: predeclared checkpoint selection and metrics only

input.augmentation: source-only span mask p0.5, 90 bins, same interval across directions

model.architecture: wide progressive generator + BatchNorm + unchanged Transformer

distillation.teacher_logits: arithmetic mean of three fixed wide_bn raw logits
distillation.shuffled_control: one fixed source-row permutation per student seed, same teacher logit multiset

checkpoint_selection: maximum valid accuracy, earliest strict improvement
scope: TemporalDrift source/valid development only; no future, WTT-Time, AWF, TTA or external evaluation
